items.title: New Cygnal poll (released Oct 13): Democrats lead generic congressional ballot by 9 points
items.summary: Republican-leaning pollster Cygnal surveyed 1,500 likely midterm voters nationwide Oct 7-10 (MoE ±2.5): Democrats lead 51%-42% on the generic congressional ballot (D+9). A GOP pollster showing a 9-point Democratic edge; the poll also found 63% say the country is on the wrong track. RCP's average (which includes the Cygnal survey) stands at Dems +8.3 (50.2 vs 41.9); Silver Bulletin's average is D+8.8. Reported by USA Today Oct 14.

items.title: Civiqs tracker refresh: Trump net-positive in just 10 states; Montana flips to a 46-46 tie
items.summary: USA Today reports an updated Civiqs state-by-state tracker (published Oct 14): Trump's approval is now above water in only 10 states — Alabama, Arkansas, Idaho, Kansas, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Utah, West Virginia and Wyoming — all of which backed him in the last three presidential cycles. Montana, net-positive in the Oct 6 reading, is now tied 46%-46%. Wyoming remains his strongest state at +16 net. The piece also carries Oct 14 approval averages: RCP 38.6/59.3, NYT 37/60, Silver Bulletin 37.5/59.7 — in line with the ~-22 net baseline.
